name: Aes67OcaMediaTransportSession
comment: Informative specialization note for OcaMediaTransportSession as used by Aes67OcaMediaTransportSessionAgent. Draft 261030 types Sessions as OcaList<OcaMediaTransportSession>; AdaptationData shall be an OcaParameterRecord with AES70-21 Table 24 elements: to, from, user-agent (read-only optional), _server (conditional), _sdpInitial (conditional), _sdpFinal (read-only required).

properties.name: IDInternal
properties.comment: Internal ID, unique within OcaMediaTransportSessionAgent instance.

properties.name: IDExternal
properties.comment: External ID published to the network. Format is adaptation-specific.

properties.name: StreamingEnabled
properties.comment: TRUE if and only if media streaming is allowed.

properties.name: AdaptationData
properties.comment: SIP parameter record. Normative keys (AES70-21 Table 24): to, from, user-agent, _server, _sdpInitial, _sdpFinal.

properties.name: ConnectionStates
properties.comment: State(s) of session connections. Map key is connection ID.
